title: Start coding day skill
description: Create a Codex skill that prepares the project for a workday of coding.

title: Status summary skill
description: Create a Codex skill that reports the current project state at a logical stopping point so work can resume later.

title: Finish previous work skill
description: Create a Codex skill that cleans up work left from a previous day.

title: Sync local main skill
description: Create a Codex skill or script-backed workflow to update local main.

title: Create feature worktree skill
description: Create a Codex skill that creates a dedicated worktree and branch from updated main.

title: Modify code workflow
description: Define the normal Codex development loop for this project.

title: Sync feature branch with main skill
description: Create a Codex skill that updates an active feature branch from current main.

title: Publish branch/worktree skill
description: Create a Codex skill that prepares and publishes a branch.

title: Create PR skill
description: Create a Codex skill that opens a pull request to main.

title: Review and merge outside Codex
description: Keep PR review and merge as a separately supervised step outside Codex; the user is familiar with the GitHub merge workflow.

title: Project memory curator skill
description: Create a Codex skill for durable project memory and notes hygiene.

title: Shared skills strategy
description: Keep repo-owned skills as the project source of truth and define when reusable skills should be copied, documented, or extracted.

title: Skill report skill
description: Create a Codex skill that reports the repo skills available for the current project.

title: Backlog item metadata
description: Improve the backlog structure so each item can carry planning and ownership metadata.

title: Renaming fix
description: Adjust repo workflow notes and Codex skills to use the current project folder name and Codex project name after Windows rename recovery.

title: Build three-page website structure
description: Create the initial home, project, and backlog pages for the website.

title: Confirm reboot baseline
description: Establish the current website baseline after the folder reboot.

title: Define first usable website milestone
description: Define the first useful website milestone as a browser-local pool care log with readings, tasks, and notes.

title: Editable backlog page with persisted data
description: Use repo-backed JSON as the structured backlog source, regenerate the Markdown backlog report from it, and let the website backlog page add and change browser-local backlog items.

title: Backlog report
description: Display current backlog items in spreadsheet format with a column for each backlog field.

title: Widen backlog report layout
description: Widen the backlog report description column and make the backlog form and table use the available page width with margin space.

title: Collapse page sections
description: Make the three major sections of the backlog page collapsible and expandable, show page sections initially collapsed, and make all sections of all pages collapsible to support hidden data and minimalization.

title: Add home page water test section
description: Add a home page section that lists the last three 7-in-1 water test readings, shows acceptable low and high values for each strip metric, and includes a Leslie's-style color chart with readings placed to the right of the chart columns.

title: Enhance skill report
description: After the skill name, add space + hyphen + space + short description of the skill. Add a parameter, such as --verbose, to include a longer description detailing the steps and decisions. This could be a pseudocode format.

title: Show readings in vertical orientation
description: On the home page, under the last three readings section, make the recent readings to the right of the chart display in columns. Row 0 should be date and time. Row 1 should be free chlorine. Row 2 should be bromine. Row 3 should be total chlorine. Row 4 should be alkalinity. And so on. Replace the header 'recent readings' with 'date'. The readings do not need 'ppm', but 'ppm' could be in the leftmost column, with the abbreviation. So the first entry under 'Strip value' would be 'FCl (ppm)'.

title: Water treatment calculator
description: After readings are entered, examine all values and determine a water treatment plan. In the plan, include the calculations, for example: one ounce of 10% sodium hypochlorite raises chlorine by 1 ppm for every 10,000 gallons of water. Those values are made up, but the formulas should read somewhat like this so users can check the math and estimate what the next reading should be.
